snapshot.reason: The company faces a Rs. 625 crore claim related to idle LNG ships, which will likely impact short-term cash flow and increase legal uncertainty.
snapshot.why_now: The disclosure of the claim and ongoing negotiations was filed on November 5, 2026.
source_headlines: Petronet LNG Limited: Petronet LNG Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 03, 2026, titled "Petronet LNG seeks early recovery of Qatar cargoes.Petronet hit with Rs. 625 cr claim over idle Qatar LNG shipsPetronet in talk with Qatar for delivery of delayed LNG cargoes".
